top_choice_rationale: P001 awards targeted protein degradation as a single prize part to Crews, Deshaies and Handa. The shared chemical principle, a designed small molecule forming a productive ligase-target ternary complex so that catalytic, event-driven removal replaces occupancy-based inhibition, is mature, structurally supported and independently reproduced. Crews and Deshaies supply the PROTAC concept and Handa's identification of cereblon explains the glue strand, so one citation can state a principle rather than list compounds. P002 is nearly as good but drops cereblon for Ciulli, leaving the glue lineage out of the citation. P003 pairs a narrower PROTAC-only citation with base editing, a separate and mature but distinct achievement that dilutes the part and splits the field. No award ranks last given the strength of the science.
